comment: Atlas Vector Search index over the memories collection. Embeddings are Voyage vectors stored on each memory document in the `embedding` field (1024 dimensions, cosine similarity). The owner_salesperson_id filter field is what lets a vector query be pre-filtered to one salesperson's memories, so semantic search can never reach across owners. Search indexes are created with createSearchIndex, not createIndex; scripts/apply-indexes.mjs applies this file too.
name: memories_vector
